daily_portfolio.uv_definition: GA4 active_users summed across reporting websites; a person visiting multiple sites may be counted more than once.
daily_portfolio.missing_value_policy: Unavailable metrics remain null and render as an em dash; they are never converted to zero.

portfolio_summary: 5 apps and 7 websites are tracked. 1 of 5 apps currently reports the primary outcome; recommendations are qualified by data coverage.
portfolio_summary_zh: 已追踪 5 个应用和 7 个网站。目前 1 个上报北极星指标；所有建议均受数据覆盖度约束。

what_changed.label: Yixiu v1.3 is live on the App Store
what_changed.label_zh: 一休冥想 v1.3 已在 App Store 上线
what_changed.evidence: Apple's official lookup returns version 1.3, the public product URL and the current release notes.
what_changed.evidence_zh: Apple 官方 Lookup API 已返回版本 1.3、公开产品地址与当前版本说明。

what_changed.label: Wendao: Daodejing is live on the App Store
what_changed.label_zh: 三慢问道 App Store 已上线
what_changed.evidence: Apple's official lookup returns product ID 6796945428, version 1.0, and the public US App Store URL.
what_changed.evidence_zh: Apple 官方查询已返回产品 ID 6796945428、版本 1.0 及公开美国区 App Store 地址。

problems.title: Portfolio acquisition data coverage is incomplete
problems.title_zh: 产品组合的获客数据覆盖不完整
problems.summary: Only Style Atlas has a verified acquisition baseline in Phase 1.
problems.summary_zh: Phase 1 目前只有 Style Atlas 拥有已验证的获客基线。
problems.observation: Only Style Atlas has a verified acquisition baseline in Phase 1.
problems.observation_zh: Phase 1 目前只有 Style Atlas 拥有已验证的获客基线。
problems.evidence: 1 of 5 apps reports first-time downloads; unknown values remain null.
problems.evidence_zh: 5 个应用中只有 1 个上报首次下载；未知值保持为 null。
problems.reason: Portfolio ranking is unreliable without comparable acquisition data.
problems.reason_zh: 缺少可比的获客数据时，产品组合排序不可靠。
problems.recommended_action: Connect or manually import one verified acquisition baseline per app.
problems.recommended_action_zh: 为每个应用接入或手动导入一组已验证的获客基线。
problems.expected_impact_zh: 支持基于证据分配产品投入。
problems.interpretation: Portfolio ranking is unreliable without comparable acquisition data.

opportunities.title: Import campaign-level App Store outcomes
opportunities.title_zh: 导入 campaign 级 App Store 结果
opportunities.summary: Eight campaign links exist but outcome rows are not recorded.
opportunities.summary_zh: 8 条 campaign 链接已建立，但尚未录入各自结果。
opportunities.observation: Campaign links exist for eight channels but per-campaign App Store outcomes are not yet recorded.
opportunities.observation_zh: 8 个渠道已有独立 campaign 链接，但尚未记录各 campaign 的 App Store 结果。
opportunities.evidence: Published URLs are known; outbound clicks and first-time downloads are null.
opportunities.evidence_zh: 公开 URL 已验证；外链点击和首次下载仍为 null。
opportunities.reason: Engagement cannot identify download-driving channels without outcome imports.
opportunities.reason_zh: 没有结果导入，仅靠互动无法判断哪个渠道真正带来下载。
opportunities.recommended_action: Import weekly App Store campaign results and annotate every permanent content URL.
opportunities.recommended_action_zh: 每周导入 App Store campaign 结果，并关联每条永久内容 URL。
opportunities.expected_impact: Stops effort on channels that do not produce attributable downloads.
opportunities.expected_impact_zh: 停止在无法带来可归因下载的渠道上浪费投入。
opportunities.interpretation: Engagement cannot identify download-driving channels without outcome imports.

opportunities.title: Build useful static search inventory
opportunities.title_zh: 建设真正有用的静态搜索内容
opportunities.summary: Two attributable English pages create the first query-specific inventory.
opportunities.summary_zh: 两张可归因的英文页面形成首批搜索内容资产。
opportunities.observation: Style Atlas had no indexable guide or comparison inventory beyond the product page.
opportunities.observation_zh: 此前除产品页外，Style Atlas 没有可索引的指南或比较页。
opportunities.evidence: Two attributable English pages were deployed on 2026-08-14.
opportunities.evidence_zh: 2026-08-14 已上线两张带独立归因的英文页面。
opportunities.reason: Useful query-specific pages create durable discovery paths and campaign-level attribution.
opportunities.reason_zh: 针对真实问题的页面可以形成长期发现路径和 campaign 级归因。
opportunities.recommended_action: Publish one useful guide or comparison page weekly and review search-to-download attribution monthly.
opportunities.recommended_action_zh: 每周发布一张高质量指南或比较页，并每月复盘搜索到下载的归因。
opportunities.expected_impact: Incremental qualified product-page views and first-time downloads.
opportunities.expected_impact_zh: 增加高意向产品页访问与首次下载。
opportunities.interpretation: Useful query-specific pages create durable discovery paths and campaign-level attribution.

providers.name: Verified Feedback Import
providers.error: No verified feedback snapshot has been supplied.

import_errors.error: No verified feedback snapshot has been supplied.

playbooks.name: Product context before tactics
playbooks.name_zh: 先统一产品上下文，再选择战术
playbooks.outcome: Keep positioning, audience, pains, proof, objections, and the north star consistent across operating decisions.
playbooks.outcome_zh: 让定位、受众、痛点、证据、异议与北极星指标在所有运营决策中保持一致。
playbooks.next_action: Use the verified portfolio and north-star context as the required preface for every new growth brief.
playbooks.next_action_zh: 将已验证的产品组合与北极星上下文作为每份新增长简报的必备前置条件。
playbooks.guardrail: Context can guide decisions; it cannot substitute for outcome evidence.
playbooks.guardrail_zh: 上下文可以指导决策，但不能代替结果证据。

requirements.label: Verified portfolio inventory
requirements.label_zh: 已验证的产品组合清单

playbooks.name: Decision-led measurement plan
playbooks.name_zh: 以决策为导向的测量计划
playbooks.outcome: Track events and metrics only when they answer a named operating decision.
playbooks.outcome_zh: 仅追踪能够回答明确运营决策的事件与指标。
playbooks.next_action: Map each website and App Store metric to the decision it changes; keep unsupported outcomes null.
playbooks.next_action_zh: 把每个网站与 App Store 指标映射到它会改变的决策；无证据的结果继续保留 null。
playbooks.guardrail: No vanity-metric winner and no missing value converted to zero.
playbooks.guardrail_zh: 不以虚荣指标宣布赢家，也不把缺失值转换为 0。

requirements.label: Verified website analytics
requirements.label_zh: 已验证的网站访问分析

playbooks.name: Searchable and shareable content engine
playbooks.name_zh: 可搜索与可分享的内容引擎
playbooks.outcome: Reuse one evidence-backed idea across a useful owned page and high-quality visual content.
playbooks.outcome_zh: 将一个有证据支持的创意复用于有用的自有页面和高质量视觉内容。
playbooks.next_action: Score the next content brief by customer impact, content fit, discovery potential, and production cost.
playbooks.next_action_zh: 按用户影响、内容匹配度、发现潜力和制作成本为下一份内容简报评分。
playbooks.guardrail: Publishing remains approval-based; no bulk posting, templated community spam, or invented outcomes.
playbooks.guardrail_zh: 发布继续走审批；禁止批量发帖、模板化社区刷屏和虚构结果。

requirements.label: Content-to-campaign paths
requirements.label_zh: 内容到 Campaign 的路径

playbooks.name: Verified customer-language bank
playbooks.outcome: Use reviews and public feedback as evidence for messaging and product hypotheses.
playbooks.outcome_zh: 用评论和公开反馈为传播文案与产品假设提供证据。
playbooks.next_action: Preserve exact review provenance and cluster themes only after repeated evidence appears.
playbooks.next_action_zh: 保留评论的精确来源，仅在重复证据出现后聚类主题。
playbooks.guardrail: No synthetic testimonials, inferred consensus, or review theme from an empty dataset.
playbooks.guardrail_zh: 禁止合成口碑、推断共识或从空数据生成评论主题。

playbooks.name: Owned search and GEO system
playbooks.name_zh: 自有搜索与 GEO 内容系统
playbooks.outcome: Build useful, citeable pages whose discovery and acquisition impact can be verified.
playbooks.outcome_zh: 建立真正有用、可引用，并能验证发现与获客影响的页面。
playbooks.next_action: Maintain the useful-page inventory and wait for verified query/page data before scaling a topic.
playbooks.next_action_zh: 维护有用页面资产库，在获得已验证的查询词/页面数据前不扩大某一主题。
playbooks.guardrail: No AI citation claims, keyword winners, or scaled publishing without verified discovery evidence.
playbooks.guardrail_zh: 没有已验证的发现证据，不声称 AI 引用、关键词赢家，也不扩大内容发布。

requirements.label: Verified Search Console observations
requirements.label_zh: 已验证的 Search Console 观测

playbooks.name: Landing-page conversion diagnosis
playbooks.outcome: Separate traffic, CTA interaction, App Store page views, and downloads before changing a page.
playbooks.outcome_zh: 在修改页面前，分开判断流量、CTA 互动、App Store 页面浏览和首次下载。
playbooks.next_action: Diagnose the first unsupported funnel step; do not redesign from traffic alone.
playbooks.next_action_zh: 先定位漏斗中第一个缺少证据的环节，不因只有流量数据就改版。
playbooks.guardrail: A click is not a download and a page view is not a conversion.
playbooks.guardrail_zh: 点击不等于下载，页面浏览也不等于转化。

requirements.label: Verified website analytics
requirements.label_zh: 已验证的网站访问分析

requirements.label: Verified CTA measurements
requirements.label_zh: 已验证的 CTA 测量

requirements.label: Automatic App Store acquisition
requirements.label_zh: 自动 App Store 获客数据

playbooks.name: Evidence-based App Store optimization
playbooks.name_zh: 基于证据的 App Store 优化
playbooks.outcome: Turn acquisition and verified customer language into testable store hypotheses.
playbooks.outcome_zh: 把获客数据和已验证的用户语言转化为可测试的商店页假设。
playbooks.next_action: Keep metadata ideas as hypotheses until automatic acquisition data is reconciled with the manual baseline.
playbooks.next_action_zh: 在自动获客数据与手工基线完成对账前，商店元数据想法只保留为假设。
playbooks.guardrail: No metadata winner without comparable acquisition outcomes.
playbooks.guardrail_zh: 没有可比的获客结果，不宣布元数据赢家。

requirements.label: Automatic App Store acquisition
requirements.label_zh: 自动 App Store 获客数据

playbooks.name: Evidence-threshold experiments
playbooks.outcome: Define a hypothesis, primary metric, sample threshold, stop rule, and attribution path before launch.
playbooks.outcome_zh: 在启动前明确假设、主指标、样本阈值、停止规则与归因路径。
playbooks.next_action: Keep current experiments inconclusive until direct or strong outcome evidence reaches the declared threshold.
playbooks.next_action_zh: 在直接或强结果证据达到声明阈值前，现有实验继续保持无结论。
playbooks.guardrail: No winner from directional traffic, partial attribution, or an underpowered sample.
playbooks.guardrail_zh: 不从方向性流量、部分归因或样本不足的数据中宣布赢家。

requirements.label: Automatic App Store acquisition
requirements.label_zh: 自动 App Store 获客数据

playbooks.name: Measured growth loop
playbooks.outcome: Run input → action → output → feedback only when the feedback can change the next cycle.
playbooks.outcome_zh: 只有反馈能够改变下一轮时，才运行“输入 → 行动 → 输出 → 反馈”闭环。
playbooks.next_action: Remain frozen until the Phase 4 gate and attributable feedback loop are both verified.
playbooks.next_action_zh: 在 Phase 4 门禁与可归因反馈闭环均被验证前继续冻结。
playbooks.guardrail: No loop without measurable feedback, an owner, a cadence, and an explicit stop condition.
playbooks.guardrail_zh: 没有可测反馈、责任人、节奏和明确停止条件，就不建立闭环。

requirements.label: Provider-backed COO cycle
requirements.label_zh: 真实 Provider-backed COO 周期
